$comment: Windows dependency manifest for the MoonRay stack (Milestones 2-3). Installed by scripts/build-moonray-deps-windows.ps1 into external/vcpkg-installed. The builtin-baseline is the pinned external/vcpkg checkout (release tag 2026.07.29); update both together. Only Lua is version-pinned (to the upstream superbuild's 5.4 line; vcpkg defaults to 5.5). The image/volume stack deliberately uses the baseline's MODERN versions (OpenEXR 3.4, OpenImageIO 3.1, OpenVDB 12, Imath 3) rather than the superbuild's 2020-era pins: the old OpenImageIO 2.3 cannot build against Boost 1.91 (boost::filesystem::is_regular was removed) and its registry hash is stale — see docs/WINDOWS_PORT.md 'Milestone 3 blockers'. The consequence is that the moonray core's OIIO/OpenEXR/OpenVDB API usage is ported forward on Windows. OIDN is not in vcpkg and comes as a prebuilt release zip via the build script.
name: openmoonray-anari-windows-deps

dependencies.$comment: ray-mask is NOT one of the embree port's default features, and MoonRay's whole visibility system is built on Embree ray masks: camera/shadow/diffuse/glossy visibility flags, and - the one that makes it visible - the separation of volume rays from surface rays. Without it every ray hits every geometry, a volume's proxy geometry is hit as a surface, the primary ray's tfar is clipped there, and the volume integration covers a sliver of the volume instead of all of it (docs/WINDOWS_PORT.md).
dependencies.name: embree
